preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
For each test case, n must be between 1 and 50,000, and m must be between 2 and 1,000,000,000.
For each test case, k must be between 1 and 50,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: All elements in array a must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= 10**9 for b_i in b)
preconditions.description: All elements in array b must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.
The sum of n and k across all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'Yes' or 'No' for each test case.

postconditions.expression: any(a == b for a, b in zip(a, b))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', then array a can be transformed into array b using the defined operations.

postconditions.expression: not any(a == b for a, b in zip(a, b))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'No', then array a cannot be transformed into array b using the defined operations.
